matter_background.original: Anura De Silva entered into a Lease Agreement which was Notarially attested on 1st March 2016 with Sunil Peiris to lease out his house situated in Dehiwala for a monthly rental of Rs. 50,000/- for 2 years. In 2017 March he discussed with the Bank to mortgage this property and obtain a loan of R$ 1,000,000/
